label: Unified Care Model
comment: Complete UCM model including Core, Participation, and Domain semantic layers.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#ActivityFocus.label: Activity Focus
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#ActivityFocus.comment: The matter, condition, or situation toward which a coordinated activity is orchestrated and which the activity seeks to jointly maintain, update, resolve, or bring about.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CareCommitment.label: Care Commitment
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CareCommitment.comment: A continuing agreement among participants to coordinate care toward a joint purpose, according to terms or conditions that may evolve.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CareCoverageGap.label: Care Coverage Gap
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CareCoverageGap.comment: A condition in which a care coverage requirement is in force but is not satisfied by any applicable in-force care commitment during a specified interval.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CareCoverageRequirement.label: Care Coverage Requirement
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CareCoverageRequirement.comment: A requirement that some participation in care coordination concerns an activity focus, in a given role, over a defined context or interval.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CareTrajectoryContext.label: Care Trajectory Context
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CareTrajectoryContext.comment: A position or extent defined relative to the progression of a care process, state trajectory, or coordinated activity, which does not require anchoring to clock or calendar time.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CoordinationRequest.label: Care Coordination Request
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CoordinationRequest.comment: A process in which coordination is requested between participating entities.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CoordinativeActivity.label: Coordinative Care Activity
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#CoordinativeActivity.comment: A situated activity whose process is shared by participating entities in its care coordination lifecycle.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#DefinitionArtifact.label: Definition Artifact
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#DefinitionArtifact.comment: A ruleset, policy definition, constraint, or governance artifact.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Entity.label: Entity
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Entity.comment: A stable independently identifiable semantic thing.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Handshake.label: Handshake
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Handshake.comment: A coordinative process through which participating entities negotiate mutual participation in a shared activity.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#InformationArtifact.label: Information Artifact
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#InformationArtifact.comment: A logical information abstraction or computable information object.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#MatchClaim.label: Match Claim
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#MatchClaim.comment: An assertion that two or more entity references co-refer to the same identifiable entity.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Membership.label: Membership
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Membership.comment: Contextual membership relationship between an Entity and a SocialGroupEntity.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#MembershipCriteria.label: Membership Criteria
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#MembershipCriteria.comment: Rules or conditions defining membership within a SocialGroupEntity.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Organization.label: Organization
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Organization.comment: Operational or governance-oriented social entity maintaining continuity independent of membership changes.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Participation.label: Participation
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Participation.comment: Contextual involvement of an Entity within a Process and Semantic Context.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Person.label: Person
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Person.comment: A homo sapiens (NCBI) with the social context of a Person.  Looking for an object property of cco:PersonRole to have a "similar to" skos: relationship.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Process.label: Process
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Process.comment: A bounded interaction or activity occurring over time.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Role.label: Role
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Role.comment: A contextual, anti-rigid classification assumed through participation.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#SemanticContext.label: Semantic Context
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#SemanticContext.comment: An interpretive environment, governance scope, or applicability boundary.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#SocialGroupEntity.label: Social Group Entity
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#SocialGroupEntity.comment: A collective grouping of participating entities.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Statement.label: Statement
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#Statement.comment: An informational assertion, finding, determination, or conclusion.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#acceptsRequest.label: accepts request
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#acceptsRequest.comment: A participating entity accepts a care coordination request.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#enactiveDuring.label: enactive during
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#enactiveDuring.comment: Relates a participation to the temporal extent during which that participation is enactive.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasActivityFocus.label: has activity focus
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasActivityFocus.comment: Situates a process within an activity focus.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasCareTrajectoryContext.label: has care trajectory context
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasCareTrajectoryContext.comment: Relates a UCM semantic subject to a temporal position or extent defined relative to the internal progression of a process, state trajectory, or coordinated activity rather than directly relative to an external clock or calendar.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasClient.label: has client
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasClient.comment: Convenience projection derived from participation semantics.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasLifecycleState.label: has lifecycle state
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasLifecycleState.comment: Relates a process to a lifecycle state.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasPatient.label: has patient
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasPatient.comment: Convenience projection derived from participation semantics.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasResident.label: has resident
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasResident.comment: Convenience projection derived from participation semantics.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasTemporalContext.label: has temporal context
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#hasTemporalContext.comment: Relates a UCM semantic subject to a temporal entity that qualifies when that subject occurs, obtains, applies, participates, or is otherwise temporally situated.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#negotiates.label: negotiates
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#negotiates.comment: Relates a handshake to the care coordination process whose participation relationship it negotiates.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#occursDuring.label: occurs during
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#occursDuring.comment: Relates a process to the temporal extent during which the process occurs.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#statementSubject.label: statement subject
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#statementSubject.comment: Relates a statement to the contextual participation it is about.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#validDuring.label: valid during
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#validDuring.comment: Relates a semantic subject or statement to the temporal extent during which its described condition, state, relationship, participation, or other semantics apply.

urn:w3c:cg:ucm#LifecycleState.label: Lifecycle State
urn:w3c:cg:ucm#LifecycleState.description: A state associated with a process during a portion of its lifecycle.

concepts.label: Accepted Care Coordination Lifecycle
concepts.definition: A care coordination request that has been accepted for ongoing care.

properties.message: acceptsRequest target is not typed as ucm:Participation.
Activity focus is not typed as ucm:ActivityFocus.
Affiliation target is not typed as ucm:Organization.
Care trajectory context is not typed as ucm:CareTrajectoryContext.
definedByArtifact target is not typed as ucm:DefinitionArtifact.

sparql.message: Coordination process declares no activity focus, directly or through a process it negotiates.
Participation uses both validFrom/validTo and enactiveDuring. The two encodings can diverge; prefer enactiveDuring.
Handshake negotiates itself, directly or through a chain: the negotiation has no base case.

properties.message: A handshake negotiates participation in at least one process.

sparql.message: Lifecycle state is neither in ucm:LifecycleState nor SKOS-mapped to a concept that is.

properties.message: A process holds at most one lifecycle state, identified by IRI. (Relax to temporalized state assertions once those exist.)
A membership belongs to exactly one member entity (via hasMembership).
A membership is in exactly one social group.
Membership target is not typed as ucm:SocialGroupEntity.

sparql.message: An entity participates through this participation via participatesThrough, but the participation names a different participating entity.
A process lists this participation via hasParticipant, but the participation occurs within a different process.

properties.message: Assumed role is not typed as ucm:Role.
A participation occurs within exactly one process.
The process a participation occurs within is not typed as ucm:Process.
A participation has exactly one participating entity, which must be a node, not a literal.
Participating entity is not typed as ucm:Entity or a subclass. Assert a UCM type, or validate with OWL RL inference if it is typed in a mapped ontology.
Participation context is not typed as ucm:SemanticContext.
validFrom is single-valued and must be xsd:dateTime or xsd:dateTimeStamp.
validTo is single-valued and must be xsd:dateTime or xsd:dateTimeStamp.

sparql.message: Convenience projection (hasClient/hasPatient/hasResident) has no backing participation with the matching role.

properties.message: Generating process is not typed as ucm:Process.
Statement declares no semantic context; its interpretation depends on one.
A statement is made once: statementDate is single-valued and must be xsd:dateTime or xsd:dateTimeStamp.
Statement subject is not typed as ucm:Participation.

shapes.message: Temporal context must be an OWL-Time entity, not a literal. Wrap a bare timestamp in a time:Instant.
